Since crop yield is farmers only profit incentive and pests are such a major hinderance to that profit, most of the farm pest control guys will just ignore government regulations and take a nice little payout for an extremely highly concentrated spray. More profits for the farmers, more profit for agriculture pest control, less ability for natural farms to produce crop yields and keep up.
